SELECT "order_rows"."month" "month", "order_rows"."sum_order_rows_o" "revenue_usd", "order_rows"."sum_case_when_or" "large_order_reve" 
FROM (
  SELECT "order_rows"."month" "month", SUM("order_rows"."order_revenue_us") "sum_order_rows_o", SUM(CASE WHEN ("order_rows"."order_revenue_us" >= 50) THEN "order_rows"."order_revenue_us" ELSE 0 END) "sum_case_when_or" 
  FROM (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "month", order_total_cents / 100.0 "order_revenue_us" 
    FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
  ) AS "order_rows"
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY "order_rows"."month" ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "order_rows"
LIMIT 50000
